{{Top|leg}}
'''Gektl painted eggs''' were a form of art created by the [[Gektl]]s of [[Hoszh Iszhir]]. Each [[Egg/Legends|egg]], when displayed in the correct light, showed scenes of significant events in Gektl history. They were regarded as extremely beautiful and were some of the most highly prized collectibles in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
